clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, a Strangely Marked Box is found among cargo on dead sea turtles. Its runes point to the naga and show that the turtles did not come ashore by chance.

Dead sea turtles and other sea creatures wash up on Darkshore's beaches. Some carry broken harnesses and carriages strapped to their shells. Sealed boxes marked with foreign, winding runes lie among the wreckage. Greymist murlocs often shelter in the hollow ribs and broken wagons, feeding on the carcasses and guarding what remains.
